recognize_zh: 抹片中的母細胞核染色質細緻、核仁不明顯，淡灰藍色細胞質的邊緣有一圈細小空泡（周邊微空泡，像一串珍珠）。流式細胞圖顯示 CD34 陰性的母細胞族群 CD123 強陽性、CD56 與 CD4 陽性、HLA-DR 陽性，符合母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）。
features: Medium to large blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm with small vacuoles lining the cell membrane (peripheral microvacuoles, 'pearl necklace')
Hypercellular marrow biopsy with diffuse interstitial sheets of monotonous blasts replacing normal hematopoiesis; scattered megakaryocytes, some small and hypolobated
Background dysplasia: hypogranular neutrophil with abnormal nuclear segmentation and a megakaryocyte with widely separated nuclei on aspirate

Flow cytometry: CD45-dim, low side-scatter blasts (~13%) that are CD34-negative, bright CD123+, CD56+, CD4+, HLA-DR+, CD38 dim to negative, CD33 negative to dim, CD15-, CD19-, partial CD2; a separate small CD34+ myeloblast population
Diffuse membranous IHC positivity and strong nuclear IHC positivity in most infiltrating cells; NGS shows TP53 p.H179R and c.782+2T>G with copy-number loss of TP53 and 5q
describe_en: Peripheral blood and bone marrow aspirate smears show circulating and marrow blasts of intermediate to large size with fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm containing peripheral microvacuoles; background neutrophils and megakaryocytes show dysplastic features. The core biopsy is hypercellular with diffuse interstitial sheets of monotonous blasts; immunohistochemistry shows diffuse membranous staining and strong nuclear staining in the majority of the infiltrate (individual markers are not labeled in the images). Flow cytometry identifies a CD45-dim, low side-scatter population lacking CD34, CD15 and CD19 that brightly expresses CD123 and co-expresses CD56, CD4 and HLA-DR, distinct from a small residual CD34+ myeloblast population. Sequencing shows two TP53 variants (p.H179R and c.782+2T>G) with TP53 and 5q copy-number loss. Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm involving marrow, arising in a background of myelodysplasia.

ddx.dx: AML with monocytic differentiation (acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia)
ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts can express CD4, CD56 and CD123 but usually show folded nuclei, cytoplasmic granules, nonspecific esterase activity, CD11b/CD14/CD64 and lysozyme expression, whereas BPDCN is MPO/lysozyme negative and expresses TCF4, TCL1 and CD303.

Its blasts are typically CD34+/CD117+ with MPO or CD33/CD13 expression, while the dominant population here is CD34-negative, bright CD123+, CD56+ and CD4+ with only a minor separate CD34+ myeloblast population.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Those pDC nodules consist of mature-appearing cells that are CD56 negative with low proliferation and are clonally related to the myeloid neoplasm, unlike the diffuse sheets of CD56+ blasts seen here.
CD56 and CD2/CD7 overlap, but NK/T-lineage blasts lack bright CD123 and TCF4 and T-ALL expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT with CD1a/CD7.

stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC (unlabeled); flow cytometry; NGS
